title: Built with Claude
intro: The projects show what I've built. This is how I build — how I put my skills to work, and the reusable systems I've made to ship real products fast without ever dropping the quality bar.
summary: I work with AI as a builder, not a chatbot. I describe a real problem, then direct the agent to explore the code, build, test and deploy, while keeping the architecture, the trade-offs and the final call mine. To make it repeatable, I've packaged my process into reusable skills so the same quality bar and launch baseline (SEO, Cloudflare security, honest numbers) applies automatically on every project instead of from memory. It's an approach I've sharpened on Anthropic's own agentic-engineering practices and the system that lets me ship real products genuinely faster, making my own work measurably easier, without ever dropping the bar.
